ValidationRule.description: On update only: blocks the save if the Soft Drink is Expired or the new Quantity exceeds its stock. Quantity Left already counts this order's saved Quantity, so PRIORVALUE adds it back.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(Soft_Drink__r.Status__c, "Expired"), Quantity__c > Soft_Drink__r.Quantity_Left__c + PRIORVALUE(Quantity__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This order cannot be saved: the Soft Drink is Expired, or the Quantity is more than the Soft Drink has left.
